001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import java.io.BufferedReader;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.InputStreamReader;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013
014/**
015 * CSV Navigate Command Class
016 *
017 * <p>This class implements command for targeted CSV transformation using column selectors. It
018 * identifies specific columns using column names or indices and applies IRule transformations to
019 * those columns while preserving the overall CSV structure.
020 */
021public class CsvNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
022
023  private final String columnSelector;
024  private final IRule rule;
025  private int columnIndex = -1;
026
027  /**
028   * Constructor for CSV navigation with column selector and transformation rule.
029   *
030   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to select (e.g., "name", "2")
031   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column
032   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
033   */
034  public CsvNavigateCommand(String columnSelector, IRule rule) {
035    if (rule == null) {
036      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
037    }
038    this.columnSelector = columnSelector;
039    this.rule = rule;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command with explicit rule specification. This
044   * method makes the intention explicit: extract data from the specified column and apply the given
045   * transformation rule.
046   *
047   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to select (e.g., "name", "2")
048   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected column data
049   * @return a CsvNavigateCommand that extracts the specified column with the given rule
050   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
051   */
052  public static CsvNavigateCommand create(String columnSelector, IRule rule) {
053    return new CsvNavigateCommand(columnSelector, rule);
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Factory method for creating a CSV navigation command that processes all columns with explicit
058   * rule specification. This method makes the intention explicit: process all CSV data with the
059   * given transformation rule.
060   *
061   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to all CSV data
062   * @return a CsvNavigateCommand that processes all columns with the given rule
063   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
064   */
065  public static CsvNavigateCommand createForAll(IRule rule) {
066    return new CsvNavigateCommand(null, rule);
067  }
068
069  @Override
070  protected String getCommandDetails() {
071    String selectorInfo =
072        columnSelector != null
073            ? String.format("columnSelector='%s'", columnSelector)
074            : "all columns";
075    return String.format(
076        "CsvNavigateCommand(%s, rule='%s')", selectorInfo, rule.getClass().getSimpleName());
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
081      throws IOException {
082    try (BufferedReader reader =
083            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
084        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
085
086      if (columnSelector == null) {
087        // Apply rule to entire CSV content
088        applyRuleToEntireCsv(reader, writer);
089      } else {
090        // Apply rule to specific column while preserving structure
091        applyRuleToColumn(reader, writer);
092      }
093    }
094  }
095
096  /** Apply transformation rule to entire CSV content using streaming approach */
097  private void applyRuleToEntireCsv(BufferedReader reader, Writer writer) throws IOException {
098    String line;
099    boolean isFirstLine = true;
100
101    // Stream through CSV lines and apply rule to each line
102    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
103      if (!isFirstLine) {
104        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
105      }
106
107      // Apply rule to each line individually to avoid loading entire CSV
108      String transformedLine = rule.apply(line);
109      writer.write(transformedLine);
110
111      isFirstLine = false;
112    }
113
114    writer.flush();
115  }
116
117  /** Apply transformation rule to specific column while preserving CSV structure */
118  private void applyRuleToColumn(BufferedReader reader, Writer writer) throws IOException {
119    String headerLine = reader.readLine();
120    if (headerLine == null) {
121      return; // Empty input
122    }
123
124    String[] headers = parseCSVLine(headerLine);
125
126    // Determine column index if selector is provided
127    columnIndex = findColumnIndex(headers, columnSelector);
128    if (columnIndex == -1) {
129      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column not found: " + columnSelector);
130    }
131
132    // Write header (unchanged)
133    writer.write(headerLine);
134    writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
135
136    // Process data rows
137    String line;
138    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
139      String[] values = parseCSVLine(line);
140
141      if (columnIndex < values.length) {
142        // Apply rule to target column only
143        values[columnIndex] = rule.apply(values[columnIndex]);
144      }
145
146      // Write entire row with transformed column (with proper CSV escaping)
147      writer.write(formatCsvRow(values));
148      writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
149    }
150    writer.flush();
151  }
152
153  private String[] parseCSVLine(String line) {
154    return line.split(",(?=([^\"]*\"[^\"]*\")*[^\"]*$)");
155  }
156
157  /** Format CSV row with proper escaping */
158  private String formatCsvRow(String[] values) {
159    StringBuilder row = new StringBuilder();
160    for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
161      if (i > 0) {
162        row.append(",");
163      }
164      row.append(escapeCsvValue(values[i]));
165    }
166    return row.toString();
167  }
168
169  /** Escape CSV value according to CSV standards */
170  private String escapeCsvValue(String value) {
171    if (value == null) {
172      return "";
173    }
174
175    // Check if value needs escaping (contains comma, quote, or newline)
176    if (value.contains(",")
177        || value.contains("\"")
178        || value.contains("\n")
179        || value.contains("\r")) {
180      // Escape quotes by doubling them and wrap entire value in quotes
181      return "\"" + value.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
182    }
183
184    return value;
185  }
186
187  private int findColumnIndex(String[] headers, String selector) {
188    // Try to find by column name
189    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
190      if (headers[i].trim().equalsIgnoreCase(selector.trim())) {
191        return i;
192      }
193    }
194
195    // Try to parse as column index
196    try {
197      int index = Integer.parseInt(selector);
198      if (index >= 0 && index < headers.length) {
199        return index;
200      }
201    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
202      // Not a number, ignore
203    }
204
205    return -1;
206  }
207}
